value.title: Phase 2: Integrate - root compose, fs3-daemon wiring, harness extension

sections.name: summary
sections.value: "GATED on s001 phase exit + o-prime fence coordination (docker-compose.yml and .harness/extensions/ overlap). Promote the POC shapes to the repo root and pave the harness surface."

value.title: Extend root docker-compose.yml with the daemon service (binary from the build-container output volume, restart per-service); db service definition untouched from s001; daemon service mounts a container-scoped config dir via FS3_CONFIG_DIR with database.url=postgres://flowspace3:flowspace3@db:5432/flowspace3 (in-container 127.0.0.1:5433 is unreachable and connect_lazy hides it - the DB path must be PROVEN, not assumed)
value.note: SUPERSEDED by ruling 2026-08-26-daemon-native-on-host: compose stays db-only permanently; daemon runs natively on host - no compose daemon service to wire. DB-path proof intent carried by dw-0204.

value.title: docker/ dir: Dockerfile.build, Dockerfile.run, and scripts (build, reload, up, down, status, exec, run) - all honouring FS3_ENGINE; wire the real fs3-daemon binary (replaces the POC daemon)
Docker harness extension: verbs shell through to docker/scripts/*; docs/how/docker.md; README quick-start pointer; `harness checks` stays green

In-container test exemplar: the one-shot run verb executes `cargo test --workspace` inside the build container and passes; documented as the paved way to run things in the stack; the run verb joins the compose network and exports FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://flowspace3:flowspace3@db:5432/flowspace3 (store/tests/pg_round_trip.rs PANICS without reachable Postgres; the shipped default targets the host's 127.0.0.1:5433 which is the container itself in-network)

tk-0201.assertion: paved stack-up from repo root brings up db+daemon; /health returns 200 from the containerized fs3-daemon; a paved probe exercises the daemon's DB path against the db service (connect_lazy means /health alone proves nothing about PG); git diff shows the db service block unchanged

tk-0202.assertion: each script runs green on the installed engine; reload leaves db StartedAt unchanged; no image rebuild occurs on a source change
tk-0202.note: reload clause superseded by ruling 2026-08-26-daemon-native-on-host: no compose daemon service exists to reload; db StartedAt invariance was proven in phase 1 and the paved surface never touches the db service

tk-0203.assertion: the harness surface lists the docker verbs; each verb runs green; docs/how/docker.md exists; harness checks green

tk-0204.assertion: containerized `cargo test --workspace` passes via the paved run verb, with the container attached to the compose network and FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at db:5432
